name: winforms-designer-modern
description: A visual Windows Forms designer for VS Code, inspired by Visual Studio 2026.

winformsDesigner.winePath.markdownDescription: Path to the Wine binary used to run the designer on macOS and Linux. Leave empty to auto-detect (`wine64`/`wine` on `PATH`, then the usual Wine, CrossOver and Whisky locations). Ignored on Windows.

winformsDesigner.winePrefix.markdownDescription: `WINEPREFIX` (Wine bottle) to run the designer in. Leave empty to use Wine's default prefix, normally `~/.wine`. Ignored on Windows.

winformsDesigner.wineDebug.markdownDescription: `WINEDEBUG` value for the designer process. Defaults to `-all` to silence Wine's `fixme:` chatter; set to e.g. `+relay` when diagnosing a launch failure. Ignored on Windows.
